name: No-code advanced form editing and local publishing
statement: Provide a configurable general-purpose multi-step form with diverse field types, accessible question and section editing/reordering, conditional visibility, repeatable groups, appearance modes, usable local publishing and response export without requiring a hosted service.

provenance.sourceReference: User request for second broadly usable no-code form with advanced answer types, add/remove/edit until satisfied, publish locally; docs/EXAMPLES/OPENFORM_FLOW_CONTINUITY.md
